basic_details.short_information: The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released the UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Notification on 25 November 2026 for 200 Group C vacancies. The recruitment covers Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander, Fire Station Second Officer and Excise Sub Inspector posts in Uttarakhand.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: The official 22-page notification contains post-wise and category-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, salary details, physical measurement standards, physical efficiency test requirements, written examination rules and online application instructions. Candidates must satisfy the eligibility and physical fitness requirements applicable to their selected posts before applying. The commission will accept applications through its official website from 1 December 2026. Check UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: UKSSSC has announced 200 vacancies across five categories of posts. Sub Inspector (Civil Police) accounts for the highest number of vacancies with 93 posts, followed by Platoon Commander with 81 posts. The combined number of Sub Inspector (Civil Police) and Sub Inspector (Intelligence) vacancies is 112. The remaining 88 vacancies are distributed among Platoon Commander, Fire Station Second Officer and Excise Sub Inspector posts. Horizontal reservation provisions for eligible women, ex-servicemen, dependents of freedom fighters and other applicable categories are specified separately in the official notification. Candidates should refer to the original vacancy tables for complete reservation details.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The educational qualifications for UKSSSC Sub Inspector and other posts vary according to the position. A recognized graduate degree is required for Civil Police Sub Inspector, Intelligence Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander posts, while Fire Station Second Officer requires a science degree. Candidates with Intermediate qualifications can apply for Excise Sub Inspector posts. For Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts, the notification provides an Intermediate or equivalent educational qualification provision for eligible ex-servicemen. Where other qualifications and conditions are equal, preference in direct recruitment may be given to candidates possessing the following qualifications: At least two years of service in the Territorial Army. National Cadet Corps (NCC) B or C certificate. For Fire Station Second Officer posts, preference is also applicable to candidates possessing a computer application certificate of at least six months from an institution recognized by the Central or State Government.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Police Sub Inspector, Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts must be between 21 and 35 years of age. The age limit for Excise Sub Inspector posts is 21 to 42 years. Age will be calculated as of 1 July 2026. Age relaxation and reservation benefits are subject to the applicable Uttarakhand Government orders and prescribed eligibility conditions. Candidates must possess valid supporting certificates to claim the relevant concessions.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts will receive a Level 7 pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400. Excise Sub Inspectors will receive a Level 5 pay scale of Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300. The advertised pay scales represent basic pay under the respective pay levels. Actual monthly remuneration will depend on applicable allowances, deductions and Government service rules.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee for UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 300 for Unreserved and Uttarakhand OBC candidates. Eligible Uttarakhand SC, ST and EWS candidates must pay Rs. 150. Orphan candidates are exempted from the examination fee. Candidates must pay the examination fee online using the payment facilities provided through the official application portal. Debit Card Credit Card Net Banking UPI The application will be treated as complete only after successful submission and confirmation of the applicable examination fee payment.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Physical Standards Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must qualify in the prescribed Physical Standards Test (PST) before progressing to subsequent selection stages. Physical requirements vary according to the post, gender and applicable category. The above height standards apply to the Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence) and Platoon Commander group of posts, wherever the relevant gender is eligible. Separate post-specific physical standards are prescribed for Fire Station Second Officer and Excise Sub Inspector posts. Male candidates must meet the applicable chest measurement requirements with a minimum expansion of 5 cm. Female candidates are required to meet the prescribed minimum weight requirement of 45 kg. UKSSSC has provided separate physical measurement requirements for the different advertised posts in Appendix 1(A) of the official notification. Applicants should verify the height, chest and weight standards applicable to their chosen posts before submitting the application. Candidates claiming physical standard relaxation based on hill area or Scheduled Tribe status must possess the relevant certificates and produce them when required during the physical examination.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) is a qualifying stage of the UKSSSC recruitment process. Candidates must complete the physical events applicable to their post and gender to become eligible for the written examination. The physical efficiency events for Fire Station Second Officer and Excise Sub Inspector posts may differ from the Police Sub Inspector requirements. Candidates must refer to the post-specific physical efficiency table in Appendix 1(B) of the official notification. Qualifying in every applicable physical efficiency event is mandatory for progressing to the subsequent selection stage.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: UKSSSC will conduct the recruitment in two principal competitive stages. The first stage consists of physical standards and physical efficiency examinations, while the second stage consists of a 200-mark objective written examination for candidates who qualify in the physical tests. Physical Standards Test (PST): Candidates must satisfy the prescribed physical measurement requirements applicable to their selected posts. Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidates must qualify in the prescribed physical activities. Written Examination: Candidates who qualify in the physical examinations will be eligible to appear for the objective competitive written examination. Document Verification: Educational qualifications, age, reservation claims and other eligibility documents will be verified. Medical Examination: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical and physical fitness requirements before appointment. The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of performance in the written examination, subject to the applicable eligibility, reservation and appointment conditions.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The UKSSSC Sub Inspector written examination will be conducted in offline mode using OMR answer sheets. The examination carries a total of 200 marks and consists of objective multiple-choice questions based on the educational qualification level prescribed for the posts. Candidates marking more than one answer for a question will have that response treated as incorrect. No negative marks will be awarded for questions left unanswered. Candidates obtaining less than the prescribed minimum qualifying marks will not be considered eligible for the merit list. The actual selection cutoff may be higher depending on vacancies, competition and applicable reservation provisions.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification states that the detailed syllabus for the UKSSSC Sub Inspector written examination will be released separately. The objective competitive examination will carry 200 marks and assess candidates at the prescribed educational qualification level. Candidates should regularly check sssc.uk.gov.in for the official syllabus and any subsequent examination-related announcements.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC SI Medical Examination and Fitness Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates selected for appointment must possess the prescribed physical and mental fitness required to perform the duties of the advertised posts. Appointment is subject to satisfactory medical examination and fulfilment of the applicable service conditions. The notification specifies medical assessment requirements covering vision, physical fitness and other conditions that may interfere with the efficient discharge of official duties.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Service Bond
content_sections.text: The notification specifies a service bond requirement for selected candidates appointed as Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer. Selected candidates will be required to execute the prescribed bond agreeing to serve for at least five years from the commencement of training. Candidates leaving service before completing the prescribed period may be required to repay applicable training expenditure and payments in accordance with the bond conditions.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The UKSSSC Sub Inspector online application window will open on 1 December 2026 and close on 31 December 2026. Candidates can make permitted corrections to their submitted applications from 4 to 6 January 2027. The detailed physical examination schedule, examination centres and admit card release dates will be communicated through subsequent official announcements. The written examination date is tentative and subject to revision by the commission.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The online application process for UKSSSC Sub Inspector and other posts will begin on 1 December 2026. Eligible candidates can complete their applications through the official UKSSSC website until 31 December 2026. UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 Apply Online – Official Website The online application link will become available according to the registration schedule specified by the commission. UKSSSC has outlined a five-step online application process covering registration, educational details, document uploads, fee payment and application printing. Candidates should use a valid mobile number and email address during registration and retain their application details for future recruitment-related communications.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for UKSSSC SI Application Form 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the relevant educational, personal and supporting documents ready before completing the online application form. Aadhaar details for registration. High School certificate as proof of date of birth. Intermediate qualification certificate and mark sheet, where applicable. Graduation degree and mark sheets, where applicable. Uttarakhand domicile certificate, where applicable. Employment exchange registration details, where applicable. SC, ST, OBC or EWS certificate, where applicable. Hill area certificate for claiming applicable physical standard concessions. Ex-servicemen certificate, where applicable. NCC B or C certificate, if applicable. Territorial Army service certificate, if applicable. Computer application certificate for the applicable Fire Station Second Officer preference provision. Photograph, signature and other required uploads. No Objection Certificate for eligible serving employees, where applicable. Candidates must provide accurate information and produce original supporting certificates when required by the commission.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Application Form Correction 2027
content_sections.text: UKSSSC will provide an online application correction facility from 4 to 6 January 2027. Candidates who have submitted their applications can make permitted changes during this period. The correction facility does not permit unrestricted changes to every registration field. Applicants should carefully verify their personal information, educational qualifications, category and post preferences before submitting the original application. The application correction window should not be treated as an extension of the initial registration deadline.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Sub Inspector Exam Date 2027
content_sections.text: The written examination for UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 is tentatively scheduled for 18 April 2027. Only candidates who qualify in the applicable physical standards and physical efficiency examinations will be eligible to participate in the written competitive examination. Candidates should check the official UKSSSC website for the confirmed examination programme, physical test dates and admit card download information.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) to fill various law enforcement and administrative positions across the state of Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under UKSSSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UKSSSC has announced 200 vacancies, including 93 Civil Police Sub Inspectors, 19 Intelligence Sub Inspectors, 81 Platoon Commanders, 5 Fire Station Second Officers and 2 Excise Sub Inspectors.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 1 December 2026 and concludes on 31 December 2026. Interested candidates should submit their forms well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Sub Inspector posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander posts must possess a Graduate degree from a recognised university or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Excise Inspector post?
faq.answer: The age limit for Excise Inspector is 21 to 42 years, while for other posts, it is 21 to 35 years as of 1 July 2026, with relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved (General) and Uttarakhand OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 300.00 through online payment modes.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for UKSSSC Sub Inspector recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Physical Standard and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), followed by an Objective Type Written Examination (Offline) and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. When is the written examination tentatively scheduled?
faq.answer: The objective type offline written examination is tentatively scheduled to be conducted on 18 April 2027 across various designated centers in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for Level-07 posts in UKSSSC?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Level-07 positions such as Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: You can visit the official UKSSSC website at www.sssc.uk.gov.in to access the online application portal and review detailed guidelines regarding the recruitment.
